Basic embedding request for a single input string

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "liter_llm"
result = LiterLlm.embed(LiterLlm::EmbeddingRequest.new(input: 'Hello world', model: 'text-embedding-3-small'))
puts result.inspect
```
